text:
harper: quick design check — iterating on a 'mini token meter' for streaming chat. goal: keep it compact, show live token count + tiny streaming pulse, and not steal focus from the composer. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/mini-token-meter. Thoughts on placement (rail vs footer), stop/regenerate grouping, and whether prompt library quick-insert should live in the same rail?

 lucas: Love the pulse idea. If the meter is in the rail it won't occlude content, but users may miss it when they're focused on the composer. Footer placement is more discoverable while streaming.

 neha: UX preference: footer next to send/regenerate. Users expect controls near actions. Also allows a subtle divider between live state and completed tokens.

 sam: Implementation note 10: putting it in the footer makes it easier to wire keyboard shortcuts (e.g., / to open prompt library, ctrl+enter to submit) and to trap focus for keyboard-only flows. If in-rail, we'd need extra focus management.

 aria: accessibility: prefer footer for single-tab stop/regenerate access. A few a11y suggestions:
 - token counter: aria-live=\"polite\" with debounced updates (max once per 400ms)
 - streaming pulse: include aria-hidden=\"true\" so screen readers don't announce visual noise
 - stop button: ensure aria-label explains action (e.g., \"Stop response and discard partial output\")

 neha: Copy question: button labels: 'Stop' vs 'Interrupt' vs 'Pause'. Which maps best to our backend semantics? Also regen label: 'Regenerate' vs 'Try again' vs 'Generate again'.

 sam: Backend semantics: we can support resume only for very short-lived KV cache windows. Practically speaking, Stop=discard, Pause=temporary hold+resume. I recommend keeping 'Stop' unless we can promise resume. For regen I'd go with 'Regenerate' (standard).

 harper: ok consensus forming: footer placement, label 'Stop' with tooltip 'Stop response 14 discards partial output', regen stays 'Regenerate'. Add a small "tokens" sublabel under counter for clarity.

 lucas: visual nit: token pill contrast too low on the white theme. Suggest pill bg #111827 with text #F9FAFB; on light bg also add 1px subtle border. Also micro animation for pulse: scale 1 -> 1.06 -> 1.

 aria: keyboard flow proposal:
```
1. composer receives focus on page load.
2. when streaming starts, focus DOES NOT move automatically but the stop button is reachable via Tab (tab index order: composer -> send -> regenerate -> stop -> tokens).
3. add shortcut: Esc stops streaming.
```
This avoids focus stealing but keeps stop accessible quickly.

 neha: prompt library quick-insert: we shouldn't mix it into the streaming controls. Keep quick-insert in the left rail (or slash menu) so the footer stays focused on runtime actions. Users want prompt browse without interrupting a stream.

 sam: agree. Also add tiny chevron to regen to show dropdown for quick-select prompt from Prompt Library (non-blocking). That way regen action can surface saved prompts without moving the library.

 harper: microcopy for token tooltip: 'Tokens used so far in this response (includes prompt + output)' — keep it shorter: 'Tokens used (prompt + output)'.

 lucas: small CSS for pill and label we tested in the prototype:
```css
.mini-token-pill{padding:3px 6px;border-radius:9999px;background:#111827;color:#F9FAFB;font-size:12px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.token-sublabel{font-size:10px;color:#6B7280;margin-left:6px}
@keyframes pulse{0%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.05)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
.pulse-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#34D399;margin-right:6px;animation:pulse 900ms ease-in-out infinite}
```

 aria: also ensure the final result emits a role=\"status\" message: \"Response complete. X tokens used.\" so assistive tech hears the end state.

 neha: should we add a tiny toggle in settings to \"always show token meter\" vs auto-hide when not streaming? Some users liked persistent metrics.

 harper: good call. We'll add a preference (default: show only while streaming). I'll update the comp & handoff doc.

 buildbot: deploy: playground-mini-meter v0.3 deployed to staging at 2026-03-23T14:02:11Z :rocket:

 lucas: thanks everyone. I'll draft the PR with accessibility checklist, keyboard shortcuts, and copy decisions. tagging @design for final sign-off.

 harper: thanks! I'll iterate comps and post screenshots here when ready. :sparkles:
